title: Big Shanty Estate Sales | Atlanta's Premier Estate Sale Company
description: Big Shanty Estate Sales: full-service estate sales, liquidations and auctions in the Atlanta area. We price, stage and sell so your family does not have to.
html:
Atlanta’s Premier Estate Sale Company

Your family’s belongings, handled with care and priced to sell.

We do the sorting, pricing, staging and selling, so you can focus on everything else that comes with an estate.

See Upcoming EstatesHow We Work
What We Do

We Handle the Whole Sale

Better Returns

Careful research and honest pricing mean your good pieces sell for what they are worth, not what a rushed sale would bring.

Ready Buyers

Our buyers are waiting before the signs go up. When we announce a sale, people already plan to come.

Trained Eyes

Antiques, collectibles, jewelry, art. We know what we are looking at, so nothing valuable walks out the door for a few dollars.

We Do the Work

No pricing, no sorting, no hauling. Leave the house to us. We set up every room and run the sale from start to finish.

Why Big Shanty

A Sale You Can Trust

An estate sale often follows a hard season: a loss, a move, a house full of memories that has to be emptied. We know that, and we take our time where it matters.

We look closely at everything, from the box in the closet to the china in the cabinet, because that is where value hides. Then we put your sale in front of a large network of buyers and keep you informed from the first walk-through to the final count.

Talk to Us
Ready When You Are

Settling an estate, downsizing, or planning a move?

Start the Conversation
